name: Scapula halo track: J1 is a closed cam track on low-motion scapula skin and the J2 hub rides it
family: spherical 3R, track base (J1 = carriage on a closed non-circular scapula track)
verdict: Not worth a GPU sweep as it stands (gap 87.6 vs the baseline's 68.9). The track itself is 80 % in band. But the loop that stays on in-band scapula skin closes only 64.5 % of poses, and the rigid link 2 (scapula to arm) is 14 % in band. AUDIT: death stands. Best re-measured on Bench(60,160) fast: gap 87.64. A loop following the full in-band zone (eroded 1-2 cells, no max-smoothing) closes 67-73 % but leaves the zone (track 97-149 mm or link 2 0-3 % in band): gap 111-148.
limiter: Closure, then link 2. Scapula-fixed metal stays in band only on a cap at el > ~65 deg plus a posterior lobe (45-64 mm from GH). A loop there has a two-circle crossing in 64.5 % of poses: rest (plane 30 elev 30), overhead elev 165, across the body, and the axial-rotation extremes have none. Link 2 is 14 % in band, at a median of 30 mm off the skin with the arm hanging in external rotation. The J3 disc and neck are 63 % in band.
note: Bench(60,160) fast. Best: thr ib100 (bench in-band loop), W (100,-15), a2 75, sigma -1, q 1.0, closed. Track 51-65 mm, J2 eye 74.7 mm, J3 disc 71.9 mm. The bogie pitch pivot and the 13 mm J2 radial slide are cam-set passive elements (determined by s), not counted. Red team: jam at Reach high shelf (|cos phi| 0.20); pinch 1.9 mm at the carriage (plane 45 elev 30); the loop's smallest turning radius is 8.7 mm, too tight for a 20 mm bogie.
